sections.title: Boston Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Boston's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Life Sciences and Biotechnology
paragraphs: The Cambridge-Kendall Square biotech corridor — Moderna, Biogen, Vertex, Alnylam, Agios, Blueprint Medicines, and hundreds of venture-backed biotech startups — creates the world's most sophisticated biotech AI market:

Drug discovery AI: Molecular property prediction (ADMET, binding affinity), target identification, and drug-target interaction prediction using graph neural networks and molecular transformers. ClickMasters builds drug discovery AI appropriate for commercial biotech development workflows, not just academic research demonstrations.

Clinical trial operations AI: Patient recruitment prediction, clinical site selection, dropout prediction, protocol deviation detection, and adaptive trial design analytics for Boston's large CRO and pharma research programs.
Biomarker discovery and multi-omics: ML integrating genomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and imaging data for biomarker identification in Boston's oncology and rare disease research programs.
Pharmacovigilance: Adverse event signal detection and automated literature surveillance for Boston's post-market drug safety programs.
Cost: $55,000–$170,000 | Timeline: 12–28 weeks

blocks.heading: Academic Medical Centers
paragraphs: Mass General Brigham (largest hospital network in New England), Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Boston Children's Hospital, and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center. World-class clinical AI requiring world-class engineering:
Patient risk stratification at MGB's Epic-integrated 16-hospital scale.
Oncology precision medicine ML at Dana-Farber's research depth.
Pediatric clinical AI calibrated for Boston Children's patient population.
Research AI with IRB-compliant data governance frameworks.
Cost: $65,000–$200,000 | Timeline: 14–30 weeks | HIPAA, IRB

blocks.heading: Financial Services
paragraphs: Fidelity Investments, State Street Global Advisors, Wellington Management, and Boston's $15T+ AUM concentration:
Quantitative factor research from alternative data.
Portfolio risk analytics and stress testing ML.
Fund operations automation and exception management.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks
